title: A Comparison of cluster algebra structures arising from $i$-boxes and Demazure weaves
summary: We compare two cluster algebras related to a positive element $\mathtt{b}$ in the braid group of finite $ADE$ type. One is the localized bosonic extension ${\widetilde{\mathbb{A}}}_\mathbb{C}(\mathtt{b})$ equipped with an initial seed arising from an admissible chain $\mathfrak{C}$ of $i$-boxes, which is deeply connected to monoidal categorification.
